::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 16th 1860  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** Princeton University, Parrish Collection, C0171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Sir](people/person_1143.qmd)

If you are writing to [Tauchnitz](people/person_1396.qmd),[^1] I hope you will be kind enough to express my best thanks for the very curious and prettily got up book which I am much obliged to you for forwarding to me, the binding is beautiful, and there is much interest in the comparison of the contents. I thank you too for the enclosed review of [Miss Roberts](people/person_1244.qmd)’ [book](other_books/otherbook_270.qmd). I have not heard from her for so long that I begin to think she must be on her way home, and so do not write to her

Yours faithfully

C.M. Yonge

---

[^1]: A Leipzig publishing firm, headed by Bernhard, Baron von Tauchnitz (1816-1895), which circulated paperback reprints of many English novels on the continent.
